name: Chip Poole
transcript: Welcome to the table. I'm Chip Poole. I enjoy the kind of campaign that has room to breathe: long journeys, classic adventure, and a world that remembers what the party has done. Around here, I run A New Adventure and Heroes of Emberstran, and I've guided more than a few companies through Myrdae over the years. Bring me a character you care about, make choices that matter, and be ready to discover where the story takes us.

name: Sean Poole
transcript: I'm Sean Poole. If you join one of my games, expect danger with teeth, choices with consequences, and enough momentum to keep the table leaning forward. I currently run Bloody Endeavor II and Souls of Destiny, two campaigns where survival is never guaranteed and a clever decision can change everything. Know what your character wants, watch the people beside you, and don't assume the safest-looking door is actually safe.

name: Lesley Poole
transcript: Hello, I'm Lesley Poole. My games have a fondness for dungeons, discoveries, and parties that learn how to work together when the way forward gets complicated. I run Dungeons III: kNight Watch, following the trails left by Legends of Larch and the MEAD Society. Come prepared to explore, pay attention to the details, and remember that the best solution is not always written on your character sheet.

name: Michael Hewson
transcript: I'm Michael Hewson. I like stories built from mysteries, hidden agendas, strange magic, and the uncomfortable feeling that something important is happening just out of sight. I run Mad Mage and The Silent Vanguard, where the party may be chasing an arcane secret one night and unraveling a covert threat the next. Ask good questions, keep track of what you learn, and be careful which answers you trust.

name: Tom Chernetsky
transcript: Hello, I'm Tom Chernetsky. My place in the Suwanee Gamers story includes Charlemagne's Angels, a campaign shaped by the people at the table and the choices they made together. For me, a good game gives the players room to act, gives their decisions weight, and lets unexpected moments become part of the story. Bring your ideas, share the spotlight, and help the whole table make an adventure worth remembering.

name: Larry McHale
transcript: I'm Larry McHale. I enjoy Dungeons and Dragons from both sides of the screen: as a player, discovering the story one decision at a time, and as a Dungeon Master, building the world those decisions can change. I ran The Crystal Bottle, a long journey through Arbescar and Myrdae filled with lost cities, dangerous bargains, strange artifacts, and consequences that followed the party from one adventure to the next. I believe the best campaigns belong to everyone at the table. Bring a character you care about, follow the story wherever it leads, and help us create something worth remembering.

name: Chris Glynn
transcript: I'm Chris Glynn. My campaign history here includes Curse of Strahd, Nomads, and Storm King's Thunder: adventures with dangerous roads, memorable villains, and plenty of opportunities for a party to prove what it is made of. I enjoy seeing players step into a great adventure and make it their own. Bring a character ready to take risks, support the group, and leave a few stories behind when the journey is over.
